title: Bigger E key on the pin in reach
caption: Your note from the train: "the E button indicator is almost to small to read". The E on the pin in reach is now a proper key cap: 24 px at the default interface size, a white face with a dark rim and a bold letter, level with the pin and just beside it. It grows with Interface size. The keys in the action menu (E, Q, Tab), the controls line and the Say tip have bigger, bolder letters too. Phones still show no keys.
